chunks.heading: The Endless Temple - Elaris Sel Marden
chunks.notes: This chunk opens with an abstract-darkness vignette then pivots to introduce Elaris and the living-book temple through dense expository catalogue detail (shelves, jars, cuckoo clock) and establishes his enshrined, lifelong overseer role.

chunks.heading: The Endless Temple - Elaris Sel Marden
chunks.notes: Elaris begins reading the book-within-a-book about Xandri, whose desire to surpass his dead explorer father and escape his tribe's rigid rules drives him to flee into the sand-wave desert alone at night.
